cards.title: Getting Started
cards.content:
Angular Material

Angular Material provides UI components following Google's Material Design specification. It ensures accessible, responsive, and well-tested components.

To install: ng add @angular/material

cards.title: Common Components
cards.content:
Common Components

  • MatButton: Interactive buttons.
  • MatInput: Form fields.
  • MatTable: Data tables with sorting and pagination.

You must import each component's module (e.g., MatButtonModule) into your Angular application.

cards.title: Popups and Modals
cards.content:
Popups & Modals

  • MatDialog: Used for modal dialogs. Injected via a service.
  • MatSnackBar: Used for temporary toast-like notifications at the bottom of the screen.

cards.title: Theming
cards.content:
Theming

Angular Material comes with pre-built themes (like indigo-pink). You can also define custom themes using Sass by specifying custom color palettes for primary, accent, and warn colors.

content.prompt: To show a temporary message at the bottom of the screen in Angular Material, you use the ___ service.
Order the steps to use an Angular Material component.
correctOrder: Choose a theme and typography settings
Import the specific component module (e.g. MatButtonModule)
Use the component tag (e.g. <button mat-button>) in your template
